note: Which markets and lines the Odds tab may pick from. Edit this file when a site's list is checked. null means the market has no line (1X2, double chance, GG/NG); a list is the lines the site offers. A league without its own 'markets' uses 'default'. 'confirmed_on' is the date the league's list was checked on a match page of the site; 'lines_confirmed' is false until the over/under lines themselves have been read off the page (only market names were read on 2026-10-06, see docs/market-catalogue.md).
